qr.hint: Use the qrcode library and save a PNG in ./outputs/.

image_generation.hint: TEMPLATE: put your verified image-gen binary/model paths here (e.g. a stable-diffusion.cpp build plus a small model) and call it with subprocess from run(). Fill 'download' with url/dest/sha256, then set enabled to true.

game.hint: Use the Phaser 3 game engine (a professional engine), not raw canvas: include <script src="/engines/phaser.min.js"></script>, create new Phaser.Game(config) with scenes (preload/create/update), Arcade physics, touch input via this.input.on('pointerdown') plus cursor keys, Scale.FIT so it fits a phone screen. Save ONE html file to ./outputs/<name>.html and return 'outputs/<name>.html'. selftest must check the file exists and contains 'Phaser.Game' and '/engines/phaser.min.js'.

three.hint: For 3D use three.js (professional 3D engine), already downloaded: in the generated HTML use <script type='module'> import * as THREE from '/packs/three/three.module.min.js'; build a scene, PerspectiveCamera, WebGLRenderer, animation loop, touch controls. Save ONE html file to ./outputs/<name>.html and return 'outputs/<name>.html'.

tone.hint: For music/sound use Tone.js (professional audio library), already downloaded: <script src='/packs/tone/Tone.js'></script>; use Tone.Synth/PolySynth/Transport/Sequence; audio starts only after a user tap (await Tone.start()). Save ONE html file to ./outputs/<name>.html and return 'outputs/<name>.html'.
